metrics: Seconds per round from check_pair entry. Future wait counts blocking at pregrasp only. Pregrasp-to-descent includes waypoint checks, fresh observation, approach planning and the deadline check. An absent historical timestamp is null. Full counts use arm routes per attempted strategy, through retreat in the new implementation and home in v11. Dynamic revalidation and endpoint IK corrections are separate.
